task_completion.description: Navigate to the POS Terminal window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The iDempiere window title or breadcrumbs show 'POS Terminal' and the grid or form view for POS Terminal records is visible.

task_completion.description: Create a new record with Name 'Express Lane 1' and Organization 'HQ'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new record form showing 'Express Lane 1' in the Name field and 'HQ' selected in the Organization dropdown/field.

task_completion.description: Set Sales Representative to 'GardenAdmin' and Price List to 'Sale Price List'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows 'GardenAdmin' in the Sales Representative field and 'Sale Price List' in the Price List field.

task_completion.description: Set Warehouse to 'HQ Warehouse' and Cash Book to 'HQ Cash'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows 'HQ Warehouse' in the Warehouse field and 'HQ Cash' in the Cash Book field.

task_completion.description: Ensure the 'Modify Price' checkbox is unchecked/disabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Modify Price' checkbox is clearly visible and in an unchecked (false) state.

task_completion.description: Save the new POS Terminal configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button is clicked, or a 'Record Saved' confirmation message appears, or the record appears in the list view with the correct details.

integrity.description: The agent used the iDempiere web interface rather than direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the iDempiere UI elements (buttons, dropdowns, text fields).

integrity.description: The agent did not use a command-line interface or script to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory consists of browser-based interactions with the iDempiere ERP system.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or selected the specific values required by the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the search/selection process for fields like Warehouse and Cash Book within the iDempiere search dialogs.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The POS Terminal must be named 'Express Lane 1'. Required field values: Organization = 'HQ', Sales Representative = 'GardenAdmin', Price List = 'Sale Price List', Warehouse = 'HQ Warehouse', Cash Book = 'HQ Cash'. The 'Modify Price' checkbox must be unchecked. All these values are standard in the iDempiere GardenWorld demo dataset.
